title: TRUCK BOWLING
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create original finished transparent PNG title artwork for a ridiculous semi-truck arcade party game, strongly evoking 1997–2002 PS1/PS2 mascot-game box art. The supplied image is a STYLE reference only, NOT a layout template; invent a distinct sport-specific composition. Chunky asymmetric hand-drawn lettering with playful uneven proportions, sculpted angular bevels, thick blue-black outline and cream outer keyline. Bold 3-tone painted color planes, faceted low-poly cartoon semi trucks with oversized wheels; exaggerated early-3D-console energy. Simple confident shapes readable small. No photorealism, no fine chrome detail, no modern glossy mobile-game rendering, no pixelation, no noise, no unnecessary particles. NOT a rectangular badge or poster. True transparent background with generous transparent margins around ALL artwork. The text must remain completely legible and accurately spelled, no imagery covering letters. Do NOT add brand names or extra words. Exact words: "TRUCK BOWLING". Sport-specific concept: Purple and tangerine chunky wobbly title. A bowling ball integrated into an O, tumbling ivory pins with red neck stripes and small faceted turquoise semi-truck crashing joyfully toward them. Retro bowling-alley graphic energy, crisp bold shapes.
